name: Generic (backend defaults)

licence.name: Unknown: the model's own
licence.note: Lantern cannot know the licence of a model no profile describes. Check the model's own; until then commercial use is shown as not allowed.

prompt.note: Nothing is known about the model, so nothing is said about how to prompt it.

resolution.note: 8 is the latent downscale of the VAEs sd.cpp runs, the smallest multiple any of its image models needs; a family's own profile may need 16 or 64.

notes: For a model no profile describes, or one whose family Lantern could not guess when it was added (A26): every default is the route's own, which for sd-server is its command line, and nothing is narrowed beyond what the route says.
Edit is left out: a backend may take reference images whatever its model, and a model that cannot use them ignores them. Choose the model's family to edit.
Inpaint is listed because sd.cpp applies a mask to any image model; a family's profile may leave it out where the base model needs a separate inpainting checkpoint.
